passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى أَشْرَفِ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَبَعْدُ: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، وَمَغْفِرَتُهُ وَعَطَايَاهُ، وَمِنَنُهُ وَهِبَاتُهُ.
passages.tr: Bismillâhir-rahmânir-rahîm. Alhamdu lillâhi rabbil-`âlamîn, wash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alâ asyrafil-anbiyâ'i wal-mursalîn, sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa âlihi wa shahbihi ajma`în, wa ba`du: as-salâmu `alaykum wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuh, wa maghfiratuhu wa `athâyâh, wa minanuhu wa hibâtuh.
passages.id_: Dengan nama Allah Yang Maha Pengasih lagi Maha Penyayang. Segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan semesta alam, shalawat dan salam atas semulia-mulia para nabi dan rasul, junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, beserta keluarga dan segenap sahabat beliau. Amma ba'du: salam sejahtera atas kalian beserta rahmat Allah dan keberkahan-Nya, ampunan-Nya dan pemberian-Nya, serta nikmat dan anugerah-Nya.
passages.en: In the Name of Allah, Most Compassionate, Ever-Merciful. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds, and prayers and peace be upon the noblest of the Prophets and Messengers, our master Muhammad, and upon his Family and all his Companions. To proceed: peace be upon you, together with Allah's mercy and His blessings, His forgiveness and His gifts, His favours and His bestowals.

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: ﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِيِّ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ صَلُّواْ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُواْ تَسْلِيمًا﴾
passages.tr: Innallâha wa malâ'ikatahû yushallûna `alan-nabiyy, yâ ayyuhal-ladzîna âmanû shallû `alayhi wa sallimû taslîmâ.
passages.id_: "Sesungguhnya Allah dan para malaikat-Nya bershalawat untuk Nabi. Wahai orang-orang yang beriman, bershalawatlah kalian untuk Nabi dan ucapkanlah salam penghormatan kepadanya." [Surah al-Ahzab 33:56]
passages.en: "Indeed Allah and His angels invoke blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, invoke blessings upon him and greet him with abundant peace." [Surah al-Ahzab 33:56]

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa `alâ âli sayyidinâ Muhammad, kamâ shallayta `alâ sayyidinâ Ibrâhîma wa `alâ âli sayyidinâ Ibrâhîm, wa bârik `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa `alâ âli sayyidinâ Muhammad, kamâ bârakta `alâ sayyidinâ Ibrâhîma wa `alâ âli sayyidinâ Ibrâhîma fil-`âlamîna innaka hamîdun majîd.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad dan keluarga junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, sebagaimana Engkau telah melimpahkan shalawat kepada junjungan kami Nabi Ibrahim dan keluarga junjungan kami Nabi Ibrahim; dan berkahilah junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad dan keluarga junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, sebagaimana Engkau telah memberkahi junjungan kami Nabi Ibrahim dan keluarga junjungan kami Nabi Ibrahim, di seluruh alam. Sesungguhnya Engkau Maha Terpuji lagi Maha Mulia.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as You bestowed prayers upon our master Ibrahim and the Family of our master Ibrahim; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as You blessed our master Ibrahim and the Family of our master Ibrahim, in all the worlds. Indeed You are Most Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ، عَدَدَ مَعْلُومَاتِكَ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، كُلَّمَا ذَكَرَكَ الذَّاكِرُونَ، وَغَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِكَ الغَافِلُونَ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadinin-nabiyyil-ummiyyi wa `alâ âlihi wa shahbihi wa sallim, `adada ma`lûmâtik, wa midâda kalimâtik, kullamâ dzakarakadz-dzâkirûn, wa ghafala `an dzikrikal-ghâfilûn.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, Nabi yang ummi, beserta keluarga dan para sahabat beliau — sebanyak segala yang Engkau ketahui dan sebanyak tinta kalimat-kalimat-Mu, setiap kali orang-orang yang berdzikir mengingat-Mu dan setiap kali orang-orang yang lalai melalaikan dzikir kepada-Mu.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and upon his Family and Companions — as many as the things within Your knowledge and the ink of Your words, whenever the mindful remember You and whenever the heedless neglect Your remembrance.

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ بِجَمِيعِ الصَّلَوَاتِ وَالتَّسْلِيمَاتِ عَلَى مَنْ خَتَمْتَ بِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالرِّسَالَةَ، وَجَعَلْتَهُ لِلرُّسُلِ وَالنَّبِيِّينَ خِتَامًا، وَأَهْلَكْتَ بِسَيْفِهِ أَهْلَ الفِسْقِ وَالشِّرْكِ وَالضَّلَالَةِ، وَجَعَلْتَهُ لِلمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim bijamî`ish-shalawâti wat-taslîmâti `alâ man khatamta bihin-nubuwwata war-risâlah, wa ja`altahu lir-rusuli wan-nabiyyîna khitâmâ, wa ahlakta bisayfihi ahlal-fisqi wasy-syirki wadh-dhalâlah, wa ja`altahu lil-muttaqîna imâmâ.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah dengan segenap shalawat dan salam kepada dia yang dengannya Engkau menutup kenabian dan kerasulan, yang Engkau jadikan penutup bagi para rasul dan para nabi, yang dengan pedangnya Engkau binasakan kaum fasik, musyrik dan sesat, serta Engkau jadikan beliau imam bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow — with all prayers and salutations — blessings and peace upon the one with whom You sealed prophethood and messengership, whom You made the seal of the Messengers and Prophets, by whose sword You destroyed the people of corruption, idolatry and misguidance, and whom You made an imam for the God-fearing.

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الأَنَامِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الأَنْعَامِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الهَوَامِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ طَافَ بِالبَيْتِ الحَرَامِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ كُلِّ مَلَكٍ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَا دَارَ الفَلَكُ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ بِعَدَدِ آيَاتِ القُرْآنِ وَحُرُوفِهِ وَتَشْدِيدَاتِهِ وَسَكَنَاتِهِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ، فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-anâm, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-an`âm, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-hawâm, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adada man thâfa bil-baytil-harâm, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin bi`adadi kulli malak, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin mâ dâral-falak, wa shalli wa sallim `alayhi wa `alâ âlihi bi`adadi âyâtil-qur'âni wa hurûfihi wa tasydîdâtihi wa sakanâtih, min yaumi khalaqtad-dunyâ ilâ yaumil-qiyâmah, fî kulli yaumin alfa marrah.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak seluruh makhluk; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak hewan-hewan ternak; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak binatang-binatang melata; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak orang yang pernah thawaf di Baitul Haram; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak bilangan setiap malaikat; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad selama cakrawala terus beredar; dan limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada beliau dan keluarga beliau sebanyak ayat-ayat Al-Qur'an, huruf-hurufnya, tasydidnya dan sukunnya — sejak hari Engkau menciptakan dunia hingga hari kiamat, setiap hari seribu kali.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as all creatures; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the grazing beasts; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the creeping creatures; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as those who have circled the Sacred House; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as every angel; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad for as long as the celestial sphere turns; and bestow prayers and peace upon him and his Family as many as the verses of the Qur'an, its letters, its doubled letters and its unvowelled letters — from the day You created this world until the Day of Rising, a thousand times each day.

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ اللَّيَالِي وَالدُّهُورِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الأَيَّامِ وَالشُّهُورِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَمْوَاجِ البُحُورِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ مَنْ فِي الخُدُورِ وَالقُبُورِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِالآصَالِ وَالبُكُورِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ البَعْثِ وَالنُّشُورِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-layâlî wad-duhûr, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-ayyâmi wasy-syuhûr, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adada amwâjil-buhûr, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin bi`adadi man fil-khudûri wal-qubûr, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin bil-âshâli wal-bukûr, min yaumi khalaqtad-dunyâ ilâ yaumil-ba`tsi wan-nusyûr.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak malam-malam dan masa yang panjang; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak hari-hari dan bulan-bulan; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak gelombang lautan; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak mereka yang berada di balik tirai pingitan dan di dalam kubur; dan shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad pada petang dan pagi hari — sejak hari Engkau menciptakan dunia hingga hari kebangkitan.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the nights and the long ages; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the days and the months; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the waves of the seas; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as those within the curtained chambers and the graves; and bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad in the evenings and the mornings — from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection and Rising.

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النَّبَاتِ وَالأَزْهَارِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَوْرَاقِ الأَشْجَارِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الحُبُوبِ وَالثِّمَارِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرَّمْلِ وَالأَحْجَارِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نُورِ القُلُوبِ وَالأَبْصَارِ، وَمُجْلِي الهُمُومِ وَالأَكْدَارِ، وَصَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ بِعَدَدِ مَخْلُوقَاتِكَ فِي البَرِّ وَالبِحَارِ، وَبِعَدَدِ أَهْلِ الجَنَّةِ وَأَهْلِ النَّارِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ، فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadan-nabâti wal-azhâr, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adada aurâqil-asyjâr, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-hubûbi wats-tsimâr, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadar-ramli wal-ahjâr, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin fil-layli wan-nahâr, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin nûril-qulûbi wal-abshâr, wa mujlil-humûmi wal-akdâr, wa shallillâhumma wa sallim `alayhi wa `alâ âlihi bi`adadi makhlûqâtika fil-barri wal-bihâr, wa bi`adadi ahlil-jannati wa ahlin-nâr, min yaumi khalaqtad-dunyâ ilâ yaumil-qiyâmah, fî kulli yaumin alfa marrah.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak tumbuh-tumbuhan dan bunga-bunga; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak dedaunan pepohonan; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak biji-bijian dan buah-buahan; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak pasir dan bebatuan; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad pada waktu malam dan siang; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad — cahaya hati dan penglihatan, penghapus kegelisahan dan kesusahan; dan limpahkanlah ya Allah shalawat dan salam kepada beliau dan keluarga beliau sebanyak makhluk-makhluk-Mu di daratan dan lautan, dan sebanyak penghuni surga dan penghuni neraka — sejak hari Engkau menciptakan dunia hingga hari kiamat, setiap hari seribu kali.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the plants and the blossoms; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the leaves of the trees; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the grains and the fruits; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the sand and the stones; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad throughout night and day; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad — the light of hearts and eyes, the dispeller of worries and sorrows; and bestow prayers and peace, O Allah, upon him and his Family as many as Your creatures on land and in the seas, and as many as the people of Paradise and the people of the Fire — from the day You created this world until the Day of Rising, a thousand times each day.

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِ البَشَرِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الأَرْيَاشِ وَالشَّعَرِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ القَطْرِ وَالمَطَرِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الغَزْلِ وَالوَبَرِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النَّمْلِ وَالذَّرِّ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ المَصَابِيحِ فِي الغُدَرِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ السَّمْعِ وَالبَصَرِ، وَصَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ صَلَاةً مُضَاعَفَةً بِعَدَدِ مَنْ حَجَّ وَاعْتَمَرَ، وَمَنْ هَلَّلَ وَمَنْ كَبَّرَ، وَمَنْ سَبَّحَ وَمَنِ اسْتَغْفَرَ، وَمَنْ أَقْبَلَ وَمَنْ أَدْبَرَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ المَحْشَرِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adada anfâsil-basyar, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-aryâsyi wasy-sya`ar, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-qathri wal-mathar, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-ghazli wal-wabar, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadan-namli wadz-dzarr, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-mashâbîhi fil-ghudar, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin bi`adadis-sam`i wal-bashar, wa shallillâhumma `alayhi wa `alâ âlihi shalâtan mudhâ`afatan bi`adadi man hajja wa`tamar, wa man hallala wa man kabbar, wa man sabbaha wa manis-taghfar, wa man aqbala wa man adbar, min yaumi khalaqtad-dunyâ ilâ yaumil-mahsyar.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak napas manusia; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak bulu unggas dan rambut; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak tetesan air dan hujan; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak benang pintalan dan bulu halus; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak semut dan butiran debu; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak pelita yang berkilau di telaga-telaga; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak pendengaran dan penglihatan; dan limpahkanlah ya Allah kepada beliau dan keluarga beliau shalawat yang berlipat ganda sebanyak orang yang berhaji dan berumrah, yang bertahlil dan bertakbir, yang bertasbih dan beristighfar, serta yang datang menghadap dan yang berpaling — sejak hari Engkau menciptakan dunia hingga hari mahsyar.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the breaths of humankind; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as feathers and hair; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the raindrops and the rain; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as spun thread and soft fur; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the ants and the tiny specks; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the lamps reflected in the pools; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as hearing and sight; and bestow, O Allah, upon him and his Family multiplied prayers as many as those who have performed hajj and umrah, those who have declared Allah's oneness and His greatness, those who have glorified Him and sought His forgiveness, and those who have drawn near and those who have turned away — from the day You created this world until the Day of the Gathering.

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ لُبِّ اللُّبَابِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ السَّحَابِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرِّقَابِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ حِجَابٍ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الحِسَابِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin lubbil-lubâb, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadas-sahâb, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadar-riqâb, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adada kulli hijâb, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin ilâ yaumil-hisâb.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, inti dari segala inti; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak awan; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak jiwa-jiwa manusia; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak setiap tabir; dan shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad hingga hari perhitungan.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, the purest essence of all essence; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the clouds; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as all living souls; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as every veil; and bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad until the Day of Reckoning.

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ المُصَلِّينَ وَالذَّاكِرِينَ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الصَّابِرِينَ وَالشَّاكِرِينَ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الطَّالِبِينَ وَالزَّاهِدِينَ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ البَارِّينَ وَالمُطْعِمِينَ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الرَّسُولِ الهَادِي الأَمِينِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مُجْلِي القَلْبِ الحَزِينِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَيْرِ مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي النَّبِيِّينَ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ وَحِينٍ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي المَلَإِ الأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-mushallîna wadz-dzâkirîn, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadash-shâbirîna wasy-syâkirîn, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadath-thâlibîna waz-zâhidîn, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-bârrîna wal-muth`imîn, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadinir-rasûlil-hâdil-amîn, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin mujlil-qalbil-hazîn, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin khayri man fil-ardhi was-samâ'i ajma`în, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin fil-awwalîna wal-âkhirîn, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin fin-nabiyyîna wal-mursalîn, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin fî kulli waqtin wa hîn, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin fil-mala'il-a`lâ ilâ yaumid-dîn, birahmatika yâ arhamar-râhimîn.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak orang yang shalat dan berdzikir; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak orang yang sabar dan bersyukur; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak para pencari dan para zahid; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak orang yang berbakti dan yang memberi makan; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, sang Rasul pemberi petunjuk yang terpercaya; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, penghibur hati yang berduka; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, sebaik-baik penghuni bumi dan langit seluruhnya; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad di kalangan orang-orang terdahulu dan yang kemudian; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad di antara para nabi dan rasul; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad di setiap waktu dan saat; dan shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad di majelis tertinggi hingga hari pembalasan — dengan rahmat-Mu wahai Yang Maha Penyayang di antara para penyayang.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as those who pray and those who remember; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the patient and the grateful; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the seekers and the renunciants; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the dutiful and those who feed others; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, the Messenger, the trustworthy guide; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, the consoler of the sorrowful heart; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, the best of all in the earth and the heaven; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad among the first and the last; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad among the Prophets and Messengers; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad at every time and moment; and bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad in the highest assembly until the Day of Judgement — by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ المُصْطَفَى، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِكَ المُجْتَبَى، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَبِيبِكَ المُرْتَضَى، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ سُلْطَانِ الأَنْبِيَاءِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بُرْهَانِ الأَصْفِيَاءِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَفْوَةِ الأَتْقِيَاءِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَعْدِنِ الجُودِ وَالوَفَاءِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بَحْرِ المَكَارِمِ وَالصَّفَاءِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ رَسُولِ الرَّحْمَةِ وَالهُدَى.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin nabiyyikal-mushthafâ, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin rasûlikal-mujtabâ, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin habîbikal-murtadhâ, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin sulthânil-anbiyâ', wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin burhânil-ashfiyâ', wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin shafwatil-atqiyâ', wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin ma`dinil-jûdi wal-wafâ', wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin bahril-makârimi wash-shafâ', wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin wa `alâ âlihi rasûlir-rahmati wal-hudâ.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, nabi-Mu yang terpilih; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, rasul-Mu pilihan; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, kekasih-Mu yang diridhai; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, sultan para nabi; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, bukti nyata orang-orang suci; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, pilihan orang-orang bertakwa; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, sumber kedermawanan dan kesetiaan; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, samudra kemuliaan dan kejernihan; dan shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad beserta keluarga beliau — rasul pembawa rahmat dan petunjuk.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, Your chosen Prophet; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, Your elected Messenger; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, Your well-pleasing beloved; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, sovereign of the Prophets; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, the clear proof of the pure; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, the choicest of the God-fearing; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, the wellspring of generosity and faithfulness; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, the ocean of noble virtues and purity; and bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad and his Family — the Messenger of mercy and guidance.

passages.sub: Rawd al-Anwar wa Kanz al-Asrar of Habib Ahmad al-Haddar
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الأَحْيَاءِ وَالأَمْوَاتِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الصُّوَرِ وَاللُّغَاتِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الحُرُوفِ وَالكَلِمَاتِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الحَسَنَاتِ وَالسَّيِّئَاتِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ بِعَدَدِ المُتَحَرِّكَاتِ وَالسَّاكِنَاتِ، مِمَّا خَلَقْتَهُ فِي العُلُوِيَّاتِ وَالسُّفْلِيَّاتِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الأَرَاضِي وَالجِهَاتِ، وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الخَيْرَاتِ وَالبَرَكَاتِ، وَصَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى المَخْصُوصِ بِأَشْرَفِ المَقَامَاتِ، المَمْنُوحِ بِأَجْزَلِ العَطِيَّاتِ، الرَّاقِي بِأَعْلَى الدَّرَجَاتِ، سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَهْلِ الكَرَامَاتِ وَالغَزَوَاتِ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللَّهِ خَالِقِ الأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-ahyâ'i wal-amwât, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadash-shuwari wal-lughât, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-hurûfi wal-kalimât, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-hasanâti was-sayyi'ât, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin bi`adadil-mutaharrikâti was-sâkinât, mimmâ khalaqtahu fil-`uluwiyyâti was-sufliyyât, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-arâdhî wal-jihât, wa shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin `adadal-khayrâti wal-barakât, wa shallillâhumma `alal-makhshûshi bi'asyrafil-maqâmât, al-mamnûhi bi'ajzalil-`athiyyât, ar-râqî bi'a`lad-darajât, sayyidinâ wa maulânâ Muhammad, wa `alâ âlihi wa shahbihi ahlil-karâmâti wal-ghazawât, shalâtan dâ'imatan bidawâmi mulkillâhi khâliqil-ardhi was-samâwât.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak yang hidup dan yang mati; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak rupa dan bahasa; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak huruf dan kata; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak kebaikan dan keburukan; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak segala yang bergerak dan yang diam dari apa yang Engkau ciptakan di alam atas dan alam bawah; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak bumi dan penjuru arah; shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad sebanyak kebaikan dan keberkahan; dan limpahkanlah ya Allah shalawat kepada dia yang dikhususkan dengan semulia-mulia kedudukan, yang dianugerahi pemberian paling melimpah, yang menaiki derajat tertinggi — junjungan dan pemimpin kami Nabi Muhammad — beserta keluarga dan para sahabat beliau, para pemilik karamah dan pejuang peperangan: shalawat yang kekal selama kekalnya kerajaan Allah, Pencipta bumi dan langit.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the living and the dead; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the forms and the tongues; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the letters and the words; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the good deeds and the misdeeds; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as all that moves and all that is still of what You have created in the higher and lower realms; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the lands and the directions; bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad as many as the good things and the blessings; and bestow prayers, O Allah, upon the one singled out for the noblest of stations, granted the most abundant of gifts, raised to the loftiest of degrees — our master and patron Muhammad — and upon his Family and Companions, the people of miracles and campaigns: prayers enduring as long as the dominion of Allah, Creator of the earth and the heavens, endures.
